speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I just have three supplementary questions, Mr Speaker.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I have received feedback from some university students and there have been recent reports of daily campus bus problems, issues of maintenance of toilets and other services, and also overcrowding of canteens and food courts in the AUs.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I am aware that the National University of Singapore (NUS) and Nanyang Technological University (NTU) have taken measures to address those issues.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: But I have three supplementary questions to follow up from that.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: First, whether the Ministry of Education (MOE), on a regular basis, do look carefully at the local tertiary students' basic welfare, safety and day-to-day logistics, even as there are autonomous entities involved here.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Second, whether MOE thinks that the AUs' measures are adequate and should MOE set guidelines to ensure AUs are able to handle the overcrowding issues that we are facing over the past few months; or even if they have improved, whether it can be sustained.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: And lastly, with regard to some of the measures, can the Senior Parliamentary Secretary share how some of these tour operators who are visiting the AUs can be better managed, going forward?

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: MOE also expects these AUs as publicly funded institutions to provide a conducive learning environment for students as part of their mission to provide quality education.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: NTU and NUS have taken appropriate measures to address these issues when they arise.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: And these are communicated to the travel agents and operators.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: Just a reminder that all operators are to respect the universities as places of teaching and learning, and to ensure that they do not disrupt students' learning and welfare and campus operations as a whole.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: I just want to ask the Senior Parliamentary Secretary, again, whether he can assure the university students about the bus overcrowding situation, because for the feeder bus services, when there is heavy rain, there is a bit of concern about the overcrowding issues, not just from the tours that are visiting the universities, but also in terms of the frequency of the bus services.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: Whether that can be improved, going forward, for both AUs and other AUs in Singapore as well.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: Yes, we are monitoring the situation and working closely with the AUs.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: In fact, the AUs are working closely with and getting feedback from the student leaders on the ground as well, and will put in measures as needed.
